pokedexEntries.go: This POKéMON wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.

pokedexEntries.si: When CELEBI disappears deep in a forest, it is said to leave behind an egg it brought from the future.

pokedexEntries.cr: Revered as a guardian of the forest, CELEBI appears wherever beautiful forests exist.

pokedexEntries.ru: This POKéMON came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as CELEBI appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.
